note: Re-judged 2026-11-19 after D-4 (e700fb7392), ce5c276457, 50b89fb51b, 072ef5bf1f and 516671704b changed the cited producers. RFC 4301 Section 4.4.1: "Since the SPD-I is just a part of the SPD, if a packet that is looked up in the SPD-I cannot be matched to an entry there, then the packet MUST be discarded." applyConfig still installs the catch-all first on the first apply, and releaseSPD still removes it last and keeps it when warnSPDLeft reports another entry left; Ze's IKE is exempt per socket (bypassIKESocket), not by an SPD entry, as the annotation already says. The two uncovered paths are unchanged: vppBackend.CatchAllSupported still answers ErrNoNodeWideSPD (vppPolicyInterface refuses an unbound entry), and the OSPF installer change adds removal reporting only, so the RFC 4552 manual-key entries still have no final DISCARD entry with no vpn ipsec block, after releaseSPD, under unmatched bypass, or on VPP. The gap stands.
